name: assembleia-da-republica
title: Assembleia da República
description: Search votes, legislative initiatives, deputies and petitions from the Portuguese parliament, powered by openAR open data
author: caasols

commands.name: browse-votes
commands.title: Browse Votes
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: Browse plenary votes newest first — the result of each one and how every party voted

commands.name: search-initiatives
commands.title: Search Initiatives
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: Search legislative initiatives — bills, resolutions and proposals — by title

commands.name: browse-party-votes
commands.title: Browse Party Votes
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: See how a party voted — in favour, against or abstaining

commands.name: search-petitions
commands.title: Search Petitions
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: Search petitions to parliament by subject, with signature counts

commands.name: browse-deputies
commands.title: Browse Deputies
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: Browse the 230 sitting members of parliament, by name or party

commands.name: browse-committees
commands.title: Browse Committees
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: Browse parliamentary committees and their acronyms

commands.name: longest-serving-deputies
commands.title: Browse Longest-Serving Deputies
commands.subtitle: Assembleia da República
commands.description: Rank deputies by how many legislatures they have served

preferences.name: pageSize
preferences.title: Results per Page
preferences.description: How many results each request fetches. Lists load more as you scroll, so a smaller page shows the first results sooner; a larger one scrolls further before fetching again. openAR allows 100 requests a minute.

preferences.name: defaultLegislature
preferences.title: Default Legislature
preferences.description: Which legislature lists start on. "Current" follows the sitting legislature automatically, so it stays right after an election. Commands with a legislature dropdown let you change it per search.

tools.name: get-todays-votes
tools.title: Get Today's Votes
tools.description: Get the plenary votes the Portuguese parliament held today, with each result and how every party voted.

tools.name: search-initiatives
tools.title: Search Initiatives
tools.description: Search legislative initiatives in the Portuguese parliament by title, legislature, author party, or whether they were approved.

tools.name: get-party-votes
tools.title: Get Party Votes
tools.description: Get the votes where a given party voted in favour, against, or abstained, in the Portuguese parliament.

tools.name: search-deputies
tools.title: Search Deputies
tools.description: Find members of the Portuguese parliament by name, party, or legislature.

tools.name: search-petitions
tools.title: Search Petitions
tools.description: Search petitions to the Portuguese parliament by subject, legislature or status, with signature counts.

tools.name: search-committees
tools.title: Search Committees
tools.description: Find parliamentary committees in the Portuguese parliament by name.

tools.name: get-initiative
tools.title: Get Initiative
tools.description: Get the full record of one legislative initiative, including its authors and how each stage was voted.

tools.name: get-deputy
tools.title: Get Deputy
tools.description: Get one member of the Portuguese parliament's profile, mandates and authorship record.

tools.name: get-deputy-activity
tools.title: Get Deputy Activity
tools.description: Get how much of each kind of parliamentary work a member does: interventions, requests, committee work and rapporteurships.
